description: This file defines the ProductDao interface for accessing and querying Product entities from the database, including methods for retrieving products based on various criteria such as locale, categories, store, tax class, and URL.

classes.name: ProductDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Product entities, extending generic DAO functionalities.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Product based on its ID, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Gets a list of Products for a store within certain categories, considering language and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Products belonging to specific categories.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of Products available in a store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves Products associated with a particular TaxClass.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Finds a Product by its SEO URL within a store and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Product by its code and language.
